# qrcode-generator

[qrcode.mjs](./qrcode.mjs) is the unmodified ES module from
[`qrcode-generator@2.0.4`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcode-generator/v/2.0.4),
distributed under the [MIT license](./LICENSE.qrcode).

Upstream: <https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator>.
QR images are generated locally in the browser; no external QR service is used.

# ExcelJS

[exceljs.min.js](./exceljs.min.js) is the unmodified browser bundle from
[`exceljs@4.4.0`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/exceljs/v/4.4.0),
distributed under the [MIT license](./LICENSE.exceljs).

Upstream: <https://github.com/exceljs/exceljs>.
Loaded only when exporting; workbooks are generated locally in the browser.
